title: Growing more while emitting less? Decoupling U.S. agricultural production and greenhouse gas emissions
abstract: We decompose state‐level US agricultural greenhouse gas emissions growth into output growth, input emission intensity, and total factor productivity (TFP). Combining EPA emissions data with USDA productivity accounts over 1990–2015, we find that TFP growth historically slowed emissions but has recently weakened. Declining input emission intensity, concentrated in the Southeast, has become the dominant mitigating factor. Further decomposition suggests that land productivity gains are more closely linked to emission reductions than labor productivity gains.
abstract_zh: 我们将美国各州农业温室气体排放的增长分解为产出增长、投入的排放强度以及全要素生产率（TFP）三部分。结合1990至2015年EPA的排放数据与USDA的生产率核算数据，我们发现，TFP增长在历史上曾减缓排放增长，但近期这一作用已经减弱。投入排放强度的下降主要集中在东南部地区，已成为最主要的减排因素。进一步的分解表明，土地生产率的提高与减排的联系比劳动生产率的提高更为紧密。

title: Harnessing satellite data for the next generation of agri-environmental policies
Milk composition responses amplify economic damages from heat stress
abstract: Studies analyzing the impact of climate change on agriculture mostly emphasize effects on production quantity, overlooking potential impacts on quality and nutritional content. We explore this question in the context of U.S. milk production, which represents about 20% of national animal-products. We link individual lactation records for over 6.5 million cows over 2007–2016 with high-resolution weather data to estimate the nonlinear effects of heat on both milk yield and composition (fat and protein content). While milk yield declines sharply only when the temperature-humidity index (THI) exceeds 70 (primarily in the summer), milk composition deteriorates steadily with rising THI (throughout the year). Combining these findings indicates that estimates of heat damages that ignore composition effects common in the literature underestimate total economic losses by at least a factor of two. We also find that the sensitivity of both milk yield and composition to heat varies little with cow age, farm size, region of the country, or period in the sample, indicating no detectable change in the aggregate heat sensitivity of U.S. dairy systems over the study period.
abstract_zh: 以往分析气候变化对农业影响的研究，大多强调对产量数量的影响，而忽视了对质量和营养成分的潜在影响。我们以美国牛奶生产为背景探讨这一问题，该行业约占全国动物产品的20%。我们将2007至2016年间超过650万头奶牛的个体泌乳记录与高分辨率气象数据相连接，以估计高温对牛奶产量和成分（脂肪和蛋白质含量）的非线性影响。当温湿度指数（THI）超过70时（主要出现在夏季），牛奶产量才会急剧下降；而牛奶成分则随着THI的上升而稳步恶化（全年皆然）。综合这些发现表明，文献中忽略成分效应的热损害估计，至少低估了总经济损失两倍。我们还发现，牛奶产量和成分对高温的敏感性几乎不随奶牛年龄、农场规模、地区或样本期间而变化，这表明在研究期间，美国乳制品系统的总体热敏感性没有可检测到的变化。

title: Research Priorities for Robust Climate Assessments in the United States
Unpacking the growth of global agricultural greenhouse gas emissions
abstract:
Agriculture, forestry, and other land use contribute about a fifth of total anthropogenic greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Mitigation efforts have emphasized “decoupling” that sustains production while lowering emissions per unit of output. However, the underlying decoupling mechanisms have not been fully characterized. We rely on a mathematical identity to decompose agricultural GHG emission growth (

Over 1961 to 2021, we find that TFP growth—which captures the sector’s ability to produce more output per unit of measured input—has consistently remained one of the main sources of GHG emission reduction within farms. Further decomposition reveals a key role for rising land productivity in reducing emission intensity.
abstract_zh: 农业、林业和其他土地利用约占人为温室气体（GHG）排放总量的五分之一。减缓努力强调“脱钩”，即在维持产量的同时降低单位产出的排放。然而，其背后的脱钩机制尚未得到充分刻画。我们依据一个数学恒等式，将农业温室气体排放的增长（ΔE）分解为三部分：产出（ΔY）、单位投入的排放量（ΔE/X），以及单位投入的产出（ΔY/X），即全要素生产率（TFP）。随后，我们依据官方的国家层面数据，量化了这些组成部分的历史贡献。在1961至2021年间，我们发现，TFP增长（它反映了该部门以单位可测量投入生产更多产出的能力）始终是农场内部减少温室气体排放的主要来源之一。进一步的分解揭示了土地生产率提高在降低排放强度方面的关键作用。

title: The impact of extreme heat on farm finances: farm-level evidence from Kansas
Weather-driven US milk yield losses and economic damages revealed by 9 million cows
abstract: Climate change threatens dairy production, yet a full understanding of these risks remains limited by a combination of coarse yield data and simplified models. Here we combine 155 million test-day milk records from 9 million US cows from 2000–2024 with a causality aware machine learning framework to quantify yield responses to temperature, radiation, humidity, and wind. We find that nighttime heat is the dominant driver of milk yield declines. Nationwide, heat stress reduced yield per cow per test-day by –2.5%, compared with –1.0% from cold stress. Yield reductions were most intensive from late-summer heat and springtime cold, which were –4.3% and –1.5%, respectively. Combined heat and cold stress resulted in an annual economic loss of $871 million, which corresponds to 2.3% of national milk revenue. Our study establishes the nonlinear nature of yield sensitivity to multiple weather stressors and reveals opportunities to enhance yields in US dairy systems.
abstract_zh: 气候变化威胁着乳制品生产，但由于产量数据粗糙且模型过于简化，人们对这些风险的全面理解仍然有限。本文结合了2000–2024年间来自900万头美国奶牛的1.55亿条测试日产奶记录，并采用一个具有因果意识的机器学习框架，量化产奶量对气温、辐射、湿度和风速的响应。我们发现，夜间高温是产奶量下降的主要驱动因素。全国范围内，热应激使每头奶牛每个测试日的产奶量减少了2.5%，而冷应激的影响为1.0%。产奶量下降最为严重的时段分别是夏末的高温期和春季的低温期，降幅分别为4.3%和1.5%。高温与低温应激的综合影响每年造成8.71亿美元的经济损失，相当于全国牛奶收入的2.3%。本研究揭示了产奶量对多种天气应激因素的敏感性具有非线性特征，并指出了提高美国乳业生产效率的潜在机会。

title: Impacts of Large-Scale Solar-Enabling Legislation on Farmland Values
abstract: Legislation promoting large-scale solar could potentially elevate farmland prices. Using approximately 12,000 farmland transactions (2007–2021), we study the impact of the 2015 Shared Renewable Program and relevant policies in New York state. We find that large solar-suitable parcels within two miles of substations sold for 15%–18% more than comparable parcels farther away after the program9s implementation. This effect is absent for parcels unsuitable for solar yet desirable for housing, suggesting it is unrelated to housing pressure. We also find a stronger effect on farmland in regions with higher electricity prices (ca. 20%), suggesting SRP’s impact varies by location and time.
abstract_zh: 促进大规模太阳能发展的立法可能会推高农田价格。利用约12,000笔农田交易数据（2007–2021年），我们研究了2015年“共享可再生能源计划”（Shared Renewable Program，SRP）及纽约州相关政策的影响。我们发现，在计划实施后，距离变电站两英里以内、适宜建设大型太阳能电站的地块，其成交价比距离较远的可比地块高出15%–18%。对于不适宜建设太阳能但适合住房开发的地块，这一效应并不存在，这表明该效应与住房压力无关。我们还发现，在电价较高的地区（约20%），该效应更为显著，这表明SRP的影响因地点和时间而异。

title: Large increases in public R&D investment are needed to avoid declines of US agricultural productivity
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Increasing agricultural productivity is a gradual process with significant time lags between research and development (R&D) investment and the resulting gains. We estimate the response of US agricultural Total Factor Productivity to both R&D investment and weather and quantify the public R&D spending required to offset the emerging impacts of climate change. We find that offsetting the climate-induced productivity slowdown by 2050 will require R&D spending over 2021 to 2050 to grow at 5.2 to 7.8% per year under a fixed spending growth scenario or by an additional $2.2 to $3.8B per year under a fixed supplement spending scenario (in addition to the current spending of ~$5B per year). This amounts to an additional $208 to $434B or $65 to $113B over the period, respectively, and would be comparable in ambition to the public R&D spending growth that followed the two World Wars.
abstract_zh: 提高农业生产率是一个渐进的过程，研发（R&D）投资与由此带来的收益之间存在显著的时滞。我们估计了美国农业全要素生产率（TFP）对研发投资和天气因素的反应，并量化了抵消气候变化潜在影响所需的公共研发支出。我们发现，要在2050年前抵消气候变化导致的生产率放缓，2021至2050年间的研发支出需要在固定支出增长情景下以每年5.2%至7.8%的速度增长，或者在固定追加支出情景下每年额外增加22亿至38亿美元（在目前约50亿美元/年的支出基础之上）。这相当于该时期内额外增加2080亿至4340亿美元，或分别增加650亿至1130亿美元，其力度可与两次世界大战之后公共研发支出的增长相媲美。

title: The Role of Staple Food Prices in Deforestation: Evidence from Cambodia
abstract: Research on agricultural prices and deforestation has mostly focused on cash crops and export-oriented commodities. We develop a theoretical framework to illustrate how a staple food price shock can lead to deforestation through various channels. We explore our theoretical predictions with data from Cambodia and employ a shift-share instrumental variables strategy. We find that shocks to the price of rice explain most of Cambodia’s recent deforestation. To shed light on mechanisms, we use household data to study land use behavior and welfare. Our findings suggest that staple food prices have a more important role in driving deforestation than previously thought.
abstract_zh: 关于农产品价格与森林砍伐的研究大多集中于经济作物和出口导向型大宗商品。我们构建了一个理论框架，以阐明主粮价格冲击如何通过多种渠道导致森林砍伐。我们利用柬埔寨的数据检验了理论预测，并采用份额-转移（shift-share）工具变量策略。我们发现，大米价格的冲击解释了柬埔寨近期森林砍伐的大部分原因。为揭示其作用机制，我们利用住户数据研究了土地利用行为与福利状况。我们的研究结果表明，主粮价格在驱动森林砍伐方面的作用比以往认为的更为重要。

title: A scalable crop yield estimation framework based on remote sensing of solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF)
abstract: Projected increases in food demand driven by population growth coupled with heightened agricultural vulnerability to climate change jointly pose severe threats to global food security in the coming decades, especially for developing nations. By providing real-time and low-cost observations, satellite remote sensing has been widely employed to estimate crop yield across various scales. Most such efforts are based on statistical approaches that require large amounts of ground measurements for model training/calibration, which may be challenging to obtain on a large scale in developing countries that are most food-insecure and climate-vulnerable. In this paper, we develop a generalizable framework that is mechanism-guided and practically parsimonious for crop yield estimation. We then apply this framework to estimate crop yield for two crops (corn and wheat) in two contrasting regions, the US Corn Belt US-CB, and India’s Indo–Gangetic plain Wheat Belt IGP-WB, respectively. This framework is based on the mechanistic light reactions (MLR) model utilizing remotely sensed solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF) as a major input. We compared the performance of MLR to two commonly used machine learning (ML) algorithms: artificial neural network and random forest. We found that MLR-SIF has comparable performance to ML algorithms in US-CB, where abundant and high-quality ground measurements of crop yield are routinely available (for model calibration). In IGP-WB, MLR-SIF significantly outperforms ML algorithms. These results demonstrate the potential advantage of MLR-SIF for yield estimation in developing countries where ground truth data is limited in quantity and quality. In addition, high-resolution and crop-specific satellite SIF is crucial for accurate yield estimation. Therefore, harnessing the mechanism-guided MLR-SIF and rapidly growing satellite SIF measurements (with high resolution and crop-specificity) hold promise to enhance food security in developing countries towards more effective responses to food crises, agricultural policies, and more efficient commodity pricing.
abstract_zh: 人口增长带来的粮食需求增加，加之农业对气候变化的脆弱性上升，在未来几十年内共同对全球粮食安全构成严峻威胁，发展中国家尤为如此。卫星遥感能够提供实时且低成本的观测数据，已被广泛用于多尺度的作物产量估算。然而，大多数此类研究基于统计方法，需要大量地面实测数据用于模型训练和校准，而在粮食最不安全、最易受气候影响的发展中国家，大规模获取此类数据可能十分困难。本文提出了一个具有普适性、以机理为指导且实用简约的作物产量估算框架。我们将该框架应用于两个对比鲜明的地区的两种作物（玉米和小麦）产量估算，分别为美国玉米带（US Corn Belt，US-CB）和印度恒河平原小麦带（Indo–Gangetic plain Wheat Belt，IGP-WB）。该框架基于机理性光反应（MLR）模型，并以遥感获取的日光诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF）作为主要输入。我们将MLR模型的表现与两种常用的机器学习（ML）算法（人工神经网络和随机森林）进行了比较。我们发现，在地面产量实测数据丰富且质量较高（可用于模型校准）的US-CB地区，MLR-SIF的表现与机器学习算法相当；而在IGP-WB地区，MLR-SIF显著优于机器学习算法。这些结果表明，在地面真实数据数量和质量均有限的发展中国家，MLR-SIF具有估算产量的潜在优势。此外，高分辨率且针对特定作物的卫星SIF数据对于准确估算产量至关重要。因此，充分利用以机理为指导的MLR-SIF模型以及快速增长的卫星SIF观测数据（具有高分辨率和作物特异性），有望提升发展中国家的粮食安全水平，从而更有效地应对粮食危机、制定农业政策，并实现更高效的商品定价。

title: Climate change exacerbates the environmental impacts of agriculture
abstract: Agriculture’s global environmental impacts are widely expected to continue expanding, driven by population and economic growth and dietary changes. This Review highlights climate change as an additional amplifier of agriculture’s environmental impacts, by reducing agricultural productivity, reducing the efficacy of agrochemicals, increasing soil erosion, accelerating the growth and expanding the range of crop diseases and pests, and increasing land clearing. We identify multiple pathways through which climate change intensifies agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, creating a potentially powerful climate change–reinforcing feedback loop. The challenges raised by climate change underscore the urgent need to transition to sustainable, climate-resilient agricultural systems. This requires investments that both accelerate adoption of proven solutions that provide multiple benefits, and that discover and scale new beneficial processes and food products.
abstract_zh: 在人口增长、经济发展和饮食结构变化的推动下，农业对全球环境的影响预计将持续扩大。本综述强调，气候变化是农业环境影响的又一放大因素：它会降低农业生产率、削弱农用化学品的效力、加剧土壤侵蚀、加速作物病虫害的滋生并扩大其分布范围，同时还会增加土地清理活动。我们指出了气候变化加剧农业温室气体排放的多种途径，这可能形成一个潜在的强大气候变化反馈循环。气候变化带来的挑战凸显了向可持续、具有气候韧性的农业系统转型的迫切需要。这需要相关投资，既要加快推广那些能带来多重效益的成熟解决方案，也要发掘并推广新的有益工艺和食品。

title: Double cropping as an adaptation to climate change in the United States
abstract: A warming climate expands the frost‐free season, plausibly allowing for increased cropping intensity in temperate regions. This paper assesses the potential of multiple cropping to offset the projected negative effects of climate change on agricultural yields in the United States. We use cross‐sectional variation in observed land cover, soil characteristics, and climate to estimate farmers' propensity to double‐crop winter wheat with soybeans. Our estimates imply that under current economic conditions, a 3°C warming would result in an increase of 2.1 percentage points in the share of current soybean area double cropped, primarily driven by expansions in cooler regions. A fixed‐effects panel model of county yields further indicates that yields of double‐cropped soybeans are about 12% lower than those of single‐cropped soybeans. Accounting for changes in cropping intensity and attendant effects on soybean yields, we project that at current prices, a 3°C warming would induce a shift in cropping intensity that increases revenue from soy systems by 1.3% overall, offsetting only a small fraction of the revenue impacts of predicted yield declines.
abstract_zh: 气候变暖延长了无霜期，这可能使温带地区的复种强度得以提高。本文评估了复种在多大程度上能够抵消气候变化对美国农业产量的预计负面影响。我们利用观测到的土地覆盖、土壤特征和气候条件的截面差异，来估计农民采用冬小麦与大豆复种（double-cropping）的倾向。估计结果表明，在当前经济条件下，气温升高3°C将使目前大豆种植面积中实行复种的比例增加2.1个百分点，这主要是由凉爽地区的扩张所驱动。基于县级产量的固定效应面板模型进一步表明，复种大豆的产量比单作大豆低约12%。在考虑复种强度变化及其对大豆产量的连带影响后，我们预测，在当前价格水平下，气温升高3°C将促使复种强度发生变化，使大豆系统的收入总体增加1.3%，但这只能抵消预测产量下降所带来的收入损失中的很小一部分。

title: New York State Climate Impacts Assessment Chapter 03: Agriculture
venue: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
abstract: Agriculture is a vital industry in New York State, which ranks among the top‐producing states for dairy, fruits, and several other commodities. As agriculture depends on the weather and specific climatic conditions, this sector faces extraordinary challenges as New York's climate changes. This chapter explores the many impacts of a changing climate on agriculture, the ways these impacts interact with other challenges that New York farmers and farmworkers face, and opportunities for the agriculture industry to adapt and build resilience.
abstract_zh: 农业是纽约州的一个重要产业，该州在乳制品、水果及其他多种农产品生产方面均名列全国前茅。由于农业依赖天气和特定的气候条件，随着纽约州气候的变化，这一行业正面临前所未有的挑战。本章探讨了气候变化对农业的多方面影响、这些影响与纽约农民和农场工人面临的其他挑战之间的相互作用，以及农业行业适应并增强韧性的机遇。

title: A new look at agricultural fires and health: A replication of Rangel and Vogl (2019)
abstract: Globally, over 400 million tons of biomass are burned in agricultural fires for management purposes each year, substantially affecting air quality (Korontzi et al., Global Biogeochemical Cycles 2006; 20; Yevich & Logan, Global Biogeochemical Cycles 2003; 17). Rangel and Vogl (Review of Economics and Statistics 2019; 101:616–630) provide evidence that agricultural fires in Brazil cause large declines in newborn health in downwind communities. We replicate this analysis and evaluate the sensitivity of their results to changes in the dataset and alternative modeling choices. Although accounting for the potential of spatial correlation in errors reduces precision of estimated effects, we find that their primary conclusions are robust to alternative specifications and reasonable placebo tests. We discuss how our findings may guide future research on the relationship between agricultural fires and health.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，每年有超过4亿吨生物质因管理需要而在农业火灾中被焚烧，这对空气质量产生了重大影响（Korontzi et al., Global Biogeochemical Cycles 2006; 20; Yevich & Logan, Global Biogeochemical Cycles 2003; 17）。Rangel和Vogl（Review of Economics and Statistics 2019; 101:616–630）提供了证据，表明巴西的农业火灾导致下风向社区新生儿健康状况显著恶化。我们复现了这一分析，并评估了其结果对数据集变化及其他建模选择的敏感性。尽管考虑误差的空间相关性会降低估计效应的精确度，但我们发现，他们的主要结论在其他设定和合理的安慰剂检验下依然稳健。我们讨论了本研究结果如何为未来关于农业火灾与健康之间关系的研究提供指导。

title: Structural Transformation, Agriculture, Climate, and the Environment
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This paper reviews the feedbacks between structural transformation and agriculture, on the one hand, and climate and the natural environment, on the other. The longstanding, dominant economic development narrative largely ignores nature’s influence on factor productivity and stocks, even as it increasingly illustrates how agricultural technological change and economic growth affect nature. We articulate some of the missing linkages and pose a range of policy research questions worth exploration concerning structural transformation and the complex feedback among agriculture, nature, and economic growth processes, especially in the low-income agrarian nations of the Global South.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了一方面结构转型与农业、另一方面气候与自然环境之间的相互反馈。长期占主导地位的经济发展叙事在很大程度上忽视了自然对要素生产率和存量的影响，即便它越来越多地揭示出农业技术进步和经济增长如何影响自然环境。我们阐明了其中一些缺失的联系，并提出了一系列政策研究问题，涉及结构转型以及农业、自然与经济增长过程之间复杂的反馈机制，尤其是在全球南方的低收入农业国家中，这些问题值得深入探讨。

title: Temperature Shocks and Industry Earnings News
abstract: Climate scientists project a rise in both average temperatures and the frequency of temperature extremes. We study how extreme temperatures affect companies' earnings across different industries and whether sell-side analysts understand these relationships. We combine granular daily data on temperatures across the continental U.S. with locations of public companies' establishments and build a panel of quarterly firm-level temperature exposures. Extreme temperatures significantly impact earnings in over 40% of industries, with bi-directional effects that harm some industries while others benefit. Analysts and investors do not immediately react to observable intra-quarter temperature shocks, but earnings forecasts account for temperature effects by quarter-end in many, though not all, industries.
abstract_zh: 气候科学家预测，平均气温和极端气温出现的频率都将上升。我们研究了极端气温如何影响不同行业企业的盈利，以及卖方分析师是否理解这些关系。我们将美国大陆地区逐日的细粒度气温数据与上市公司经营场所的地理位置相结合，构建了一个按季度划分的企业层面气温暴露面板。极端气温对超过40%的行业的盈利产生了显著影响，其影响方向是双向的：一些行业受损，而另一些行业则受益。分析师和投资者并不会对季度内可观测到的气温冲击立即做出反应，但在多数（尽管并非所有）行业中，盈利预测会在季度末前纳入气温效应。

title: A GNN-RNN approach for harnessing geospatial and temporal information: application to crop yield prediction
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Climate change is posing new challenges to crop-related concerns, including food insecurity, supply stability, and economic planning. Accurately predicting crop yields is crucial for addressing these challenges. However, this prediction task is exceptionally complicated since crop yields depend on numerous factors such as weather, land surface, and soil quality, as well as their interactions. In recent years, machine learning models have been successfully applied in this domain. However, these models either restrict their tasks to a relatively small region, or only study over a single or few years, which makes them hard to generalize spatially and temporally. In this paper, we introduce a novel graph-based recurrent neural network for crop yield prediction, to incorporate both geographical and temporal knowledge in the model, and further boost predictive power. Our method is trained, validated, and tested on over 2000 counties from 41 states in the US mainland, covering years from 1981 to 2019. As far as we know, this is the first machine learning method that embeds geographical knowledge in crop yield prediction and predicts crop yields at the county level nationwide. We also laid a solid foundation by comparing our model on a nationwide scale with other well-known baseline methods, including linear models, tree-based models, and deep learning methods. Experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms the existing state-of-the-art methods on various metrics, validating the effectiveness of geospatial and temporal information.
abstract_zh: 气候变化给与作物相关的问题带来了新的挑战，包括粮食不安全、供应稳定性和经济规划等。准确预测作物产量对应对这些挑战至关重要。然而，这一预测任务异常复杂，因为作物产量取决于天气、地表和土壤质量等众多因素，以及它们之间的相互作用。近年来，机器学习模型已在该领域得到成功应用。但是，这些模型要么将任务限定在相对较小的区域，要么仅研究单一或少数几年的数据，这使其难以在空间和时间上进行推广。本文提出了一种新颖的基于图的循环神经网络用于作物产量预测，将地理和时间知识纳入模型，从而进一步提升预测能力。我们的方法在美国本土41个州的2000多个县上进行了训练、验证和测试，涵盖1981年至2019年。据我们所知，这是首个在作物产量预测中嵌入地理知识、并在全国县级尺度上进行产量预测的机器学习方法。我们还通过在全国尺度上与其他知名基准方法（包括线性模型、树模型和深度学习方法）进行比较，奠定了坚实的基础。实验表明，我们提出的方法在多项指标上持续优于现有的最先进方法，验证了地理和时间信息的有效性。

title: Heat exposure and child nutrition: Evidence from West Africa
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Extreme heat shocks are increasingly linked to poor economic and health outcomes. This paper constructs hour-degree bins of temperature exposure to assess the effects of extreme heat on early child nutrition, a health outcome correlated with educational attainment and income in adulthood. Linking 15 rounds of repeated cross-section data from five West African countries to geo-coded weather data, we find that extreme heat exposure increases the prevalence of both chronic and acute malnutrition. We find that a 2 °C rise in temperature will increase the prevalence of stunting by 7.4 percentage points, reversing the progress made on improving nutrition during our study period.
abstract_zh: 极端高温冲击日益与不良的经济和健康结局相关联。本文构建了按小时-温度度数划分的温度暴露区间，以评估极端高温对幼儿早期营养状况的影响，而营养状况与成年后的受教育程度和收入水平相关。我们将来自五个西非国家的15轮重复横截面数据与地理编码的天气数据相连接，发现极端高温暴露会提高慢性和急性营养不良的患病率。我们发现，气温每升高2 °C，发育迟缓的患病率将上升7.4个百分点，从而抵消研究期间在改善营养状况方面所取得的进展。

title: On the Timing of Relevant Weather Conditions in Agriculture
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: A growing literature is analyzing the effects of weather on agricultural outcomes. In these studies, constructing weather variables requires researchers to define a “season,” a period over which weather conditions are considered relevant to the outcome. We explore the consequences of assuming an incorrect season in such analyses. We show in simulations that imposing an incorrect season introduces nonclassical measurement error in weather regressors, bias in unknown directions. We propose an approach to recover the “true” underlying season and apply it to a US state‐level panel of agricultural Total Factor Productivity. We find that accounting for seasonality can lead to substantially different estimates.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献在分析天气对农业结果的影响。在这些研究中，构建天气变量需要研究者定义一个“季节”，即被认为与结果相关的天气条件所覆盖的时段。我们探讨了在此类分析中假设错误季节所带来的后果。我们通过模拟证明，设定错误的季节会在天气回归变量中引入非经典测量误差，产生方向未知的偏误。我们提出了一种恢复“真实”潜在季节的方法，并将其应用于美国各州层面的农业全要素生产率面板数据。我们发现，考虑季节性因素可能会导致估计结果发生显著变化。

title: A Vulnerability Index for Priority Targeting of Agricultural Crops Under a Changing Climate
Anthropogenic climate change has slowed global agricultural productivity growth
How big is the 'lemons' problem? Historical evidence from French wines
How weather affects the decomposition of Total Factor Productivity in U.S. agriculture
abstract: This study illustrates and quantifies how overlooking the impact of weather shocks can affect the measurement and decomposition of agricultural total factor productivity (TFP) change. The underlying technology is represented by a flexible input distance function with quasi‐fixed inputs estimated with Bayesian methods. Using agricultural production and weather data for 16 states in the Pacific Region, Central Region, and Southern Plains of the United States, we estimate TFP change as the direct sum of multiple components, including a net weather effect. To assess the role of weather, we conduct a comparative analysis based on two distinct sets of input and output variables. A traditional set of variables that ignore weather variations, and a new set of “weather‐filtered” variables that represent input and output levels that would have been chosen under average weather conditions. From this comparative analysis, we derive biases in the decomposition of TFP growth from the omission of weather shocks. We find that weather shocks accelerated productivity growth in 12 out of 16 states by the equivalent of 11.4% of their group‐average TFP growth, but slowed down productivity by the equivalent of 6.5% of the group‐average TFP growth in the other four states (located in the Northern‐most part of the country). We also find substantial biases in the estimated contribution of technical change, scale effects, technical efficiency change, and output allocation effects to TFP growth (varying in magnitude and direction across regions) when weather effects are excluded from the model. This is the first study to present estimates of those biases based on a counterfactual analysis. One major implication from our study is that the official USDA's measures of TFP change would appear to overestimate the rate of productivity growth in U.S. agriculture stemming from technical change, market forces, agricultural policies, and other nonweather drivers.
abstract_zh: 本研究阐明并量化了忽视天气冲击的影响如何可能干扰农业全要素生产率（TFP）变化的测算与分解。基础技术由一个灵活的投入距离函数表示，其中准固定投入采用贝叶斯方法进行估计。利用美国太平洋地区、中部地区和南部平原16个州的农业生产与天气数据，我们将TFP变化估计为多个分项（包括净天气效应）的直接加总。为评估天气的作用，我们基于两套不同的投入产出变量进行了比较分析：一套是忽略天气变化的传统变量，另一套是“经天气调整”的新变量，即在平均天气条件下会被选择的投入与产出水平。通过这一比较分析，我们推导出了因遗漏天气冲击而导致的TFP增长分解偏误。我们发现，天气冲击使16个州中的12个州的生产率增长加速，相当于其组平均TFP增长的11.4%；而在其余四个州（位于全国最北部地区）则使生产率减速，相当于组平均TFP增长的6.5%。我们还发现，如果在模型中排除天气效应，技术进步、规模效应、技术效率变化以及产出配置效应对TFP增长的估计贡献将存在显著偏误（其大小和方向因地区而异）。这是首个基于反事实分析给出上述偏误估计的研究。本研究的一个重要启示是，美国农业部（USDA）的官方TFP变化指标可能高估了美国农业的生产率增长率，因为这些增长被归因于技术进步、市场力量、农业政策及其他非天气驱动因素。

title: The Empirical Analysis of Climate Change Impacts and Adaptation in Agriculture
Temperature Shocks and Establishment Sales
abstract: Combining granular daily data on temperatures across the continental United States with detailed establishment data from 1990 to 2015, we study the causal impact of temperature shocks on establishment sales and productivity. Using a large sample yielding precise estimates, we do not find evidence that temperature exposures significantly affect establishment-level sales or productivity, including among industries traditionally classified as “heat sensitive.” At the firm level, we find that temperature exposures aggregated across firm establishments are generally unrelated to sales, productivity, and profitability. Our results support existing findings of a tenuous relation between temperature and aggregate economic growth in rich countries.
abstract_zh: 结合美国大陆地区逐日的细粒度气温数据与1990至2015年间详细的经营场所数据，我们研究了气温冲击对经营场所销售额和生产率的因果影响。利用一个能够得出精确估计的大样本，我们没有发现气温暴露会显著影响经营场所层面销售额或生产率的证据，包括在传统上被归类为“热敏感”的行业中也是如此。在企业层面，我们发现汇总企业各经营场所的气温暴露总体上与销售额、生产率和盈利能力无关。我们的结果支持了既有研究的发现：在富裕国家中，气温与总体经济增长之间的关系较为微弱。

title: The Role of Nonfarm Influences in Ricardian Estimates of Climate Change Impacts on U.S. Agriculture
abstract: The Ricardian approach is a popular hedonic method for analyzing climate change impacts on agriculture. The approach typically relies on a cross‐sectional regression of farmland asset prices on fixed climate variables, making it particularly vulnerable to omitted variables. I conduct a long‐spanning Ricardian analysis of farmland prices in the eastern United States (1950–2012) and find a convergence of evidence indicating that large estimates of climate change damages for recent cross‐sections (>1970s), also found in the literature, can be explained by the growing influence of omitted factors extraneous to the agricultural sector. I propose and evaluate a simple strategy to circumvent such nonfarm influences in the form of a Ricardian model based on cash rents (2009–2016), which better reflect agricultural profitability and do not capitalize expected land use changes. The new damage estimates on nonirrigated cropland and pasture rents are more optimistic and cannot be distinguished from zero. However, estimates remain imprecise under extreme climate change scenarios pointing to a cautionary long‐term outlook for United States agriculture. The findings are robust to multiple checks and alternative explanations.
abstract_zh: 李嘉图方法是分析气候变化对农业影响的一种流行的特征价格法。该方法通常依赖于农田资产价格对固定气候变量的截面回归，因此特别容易受到遗漏变量的影响。我对美国东部1950至2012年的农田价格进行了长期跨度的李嘉图分析，发现多项证据表明，文献中近期截面（1970年代以后）得出的气候变化损失估计值之所以偏大，可以由与农业部门无关的外部遗漏因素的日益增强的影响加以解释。我提出并评估了一种简单策略，以规避此类非农因素的影响，即采用基于现金地租（2009–2016年）的李嘉图模型，因为现金地租更能反映农业盈利能力，且不会将预期的土地利用变化资本化。关于非灌溉耕地和牧场地租的新损失估计更为乐观，且与零无法区分。然而，在极端气候变化情景下，估计仍然不够精确，这为美国农业的长期前景带来了审慎的警示。研究结果经过多项稳健性检验，并且对其他可能的解释也保持稳健。

title: Market-Driven Corn Monoculture in the US Midwest
Unpacking the climatic drivers of U.S. agricultural yields
abstract: Understanding the climatic drivers of present-day agricultural yields is critical for prioritizing adaptation strategies to climate change. However, unpacking the contribution of different environmental stressors remains elusive in large-scale observational settings in part because of the lack of an extensive long-term network of soil moisture measurements and the common seasonal concurrence of droughts and heat waves. In this study, we link state-of-the-art land surface model data and fine-scale weather information with a long panel of county-level yields for six major US crops (1981–2017) to unpack their historical and future climatic drivers. To this end, we develop a statistical approach that flexibly characterizes the distinct intra-seasonal yield sensitivities to high-frequency fluctuations of soil moisture and temperature. In contrast with previous statistical evidence, we directly elicit an important role of water stress in explaining historical yields. However, our models project the direct effect of temperature—which we interpret as heat stress—remains the primary climatic driver of future yields under climate change.
abstract_zh: 理解当前农业产量的气候驱动因素，对于确定气候变化适应策略的优先顺序至关重要。然而，由于缺乏长期广泛的土壤湿度观测网络，以及干旱与热浪在季节上频繁同时发生，在大尺度观测研究中厘清不同环境胁迫因素的贡献仍然十分困难。在本研究中，我们将最先进的地表模型数据与精细尺度的天气信息相结合，并利用美国六种主要作物（1981–2017年）的长期县级产量面板数据，以厘清其历史及未来的气候驱动因素。为此，我们开发了一种统计方法，可灵活刻画产量对土壤湿度和温度高频波动在季节内的不同敏感性。与以往的统计证据相反，我们直接揭示了水分胁迫在解释历史产量方面的重要作用。然而，我们的模型预测，气温的直接效应（我们将其解释为热胁迫）仍将是气候变化下未来产量的主要气候驱动因素。

title: Climate Change and California Agriculture
Growing Climatic Sensitivity of US Agriculture Linked to Technological Change and Regional Specialization
abstract: A pressing question for climate change adaptation is whether ongoing transformations of the agricultural sector affect its ability to cope with climatic variations. We examine this question in the United States, where major increases in productivity have fueled most of agricultural production growth over the past half-century. To quantify the evolving climate sensitivity of the sector and identify its sources, we combine state-level measures of agricultural productivity with detailed climate data for 1960-2004. We find that agriculture is growing more sensitive to climate in Midwestern states for two distinct but compounding reasons: a rising climatic sensitivity of nonirrigated cereal and oilseed crops and a growing specialization in crop production. In contrast, other regions specialize in less climate-sensitive production such as irrigated specialty crops or livestock. Results suggest that reducing vulnerability to climate change should consider the role of policies in inducing regional specialization.
abstract_zh: 气候变化适应面临的一个紧迫问题是，农业部门的持续转型是否会影响其应对气候波动的能力。我们在美国考察了这一问题，该国在过去半个世纪中，主要依靠生产率的大幅提高推动了农业产出的增长。为量化该部门不断变化的气候敏感性并识别其来源，我们将各州层面的农业生产率指标与1960至2004年的详细气候数据相结合。我们发现，美国中西部各州的农业对气候日益敏感，其原因有两个，且二者相互叠加：一是非灌溉谷物和油料作物的气候敏感性不断上升，二是作物生产的专业化程度日益提高。相比之下，其他地区则专门从事对气候较不敏感的生产，如灌溉的特色作物或畜牧业。研究结果表明，降低气候变化的脆弱性应当考虑政策在诱导区域专业化方面的作用。

title: Is Another Genetic Revolution Needed to Offset Climate Change Impacts for US Maize Yields?
abstract: Predictions of future food supply under climate change rely on projected crop yield trends, which are typically based upon retrospective empirical analyses of historical yield gains. However, the estimation of these trends is difficult given the evolving impact of agricultural technologies and confounding influences such as weather. Here, we evaluate the effect of climate change on United States (US) maize yields in light of the productivity gains associated with the period of rapid adoption of genetically engineered (GE) seeds. We find that yield gains on the order of those experienced during the adoption of GE maize are needed to offset climate change impacts under the business-as-usual scenario, and that smaller gains, such as those associated with the pre-GE era in the 1980s and early 90s, would likely imply yield reductions below current levels. Although this study cannot identify the biophysical drivers of past and future maize yields, it helps contextualize the yield growth requirements necessary to counterbalance projected yield losses under climate change. Outside of the US, our findings have important implications for regions lagging in the adoption of new technologies which could help offset the detrimental effects of climate change.
abstract_zh: 关于未来粮食供应的预测依赖于对作物产量趋势的推算，而这些趋势通常基于对历史产量增长的回顾性实证分析。然而，由于农业技术的演变影响以及天气等混杂因素的存在，这些趋势的估计本身就十分困难。在此，我们结合转基因（GE）种子快速普及时期所带来的生产率提升，评估了气候变化对美国玉米产量的影响。我们发现，要抵消“照常发展”情景下的气候变化影响，需要达到与转基因玉米普及期间所经历的相当规模的产量增长；而较小幅度的增长（例如1980年代及90年代初转基因技术普及前时期的增长）很可能意味着产量将下降至低于当前水平。尽管本研究无法识别过去和未来玉米产量的生物物理驱动因素，但它有助于说明，为抵消气候变化导致的预计产量损失，需要达到怎样的产量增长要求。在美国以外，我们的发现对于那些在采用新技术方面落后、而新技术本可帮助抵消气候变化负面影响的地区具有重要意义。

title: US Maize Yield Growth and Countervailing Climate Change Impacts
abstract: Over the past several decades, maize yields in the US Midwest have risen at about 17% per decade as a result of steady technological progress. Although the trend is expected to remain positive, climate change is expected to have an increasing countervailing effect. In this chapter, I compute the yield growth rates necessary to fully offset the potential negative effects of a warming climate. Relying on a statistical model allowing for nonlinear effects of temperature on yield, I find that maize yields would decrease by −4.2, −21.8 and −46.1% around the trend, under uniform warming scenarios of 1 °C, 3 °C and 5 °C, respectively. I find that an increase of 6.6%/decade in maize yields is required to fully offset the detrimental effects of a severe but still plausible 3 °C warming in the next three decades. This indicates that future maize yield trends could – all else equal – be substantially curtailed due to the climate change. This case study illustrates how agricultural policy analysts can assess the magnitude of potential climate change impacts relative to historical yield trends to help identify targets for agricultural research.
abstract_zh: 在过去几十年中，得益于持续的技术进步，美国中西部的玉米产量以每十年约17%的速度增长。尽管这一趋势预计仍将保持正向，但气候变化预计将产生日益增强的抵消作用。在本章中，我计算了完全抵消气候变暖潜在负面影响所需的产量增长率。依托一个允许气温对产量产生非线性效应的统计模型，我发现，在1 °C、3 °C和5 °C的均匀升温情景下，玉米产量相对于趋势将分别下降4.2%、21.8%和46.1%。我发现，要完全抵消未来三十年内严重但仍属合理的3 °C升温所带来的负面影响，玉米产量需要每十年增长6.6%。这表明，在其他条件不变的情况下，未来玉米产量的趋势可能会因气候变化而大幅受限。本案例说明，农业政策分析人员如何评估潜在气候变化影响相对于历史产量趋势的大小，从而帮助确定农业研究的目标。

title: Negative impacts of climate change on cereal yields: statistical evidence from France
abstract: In several world regions, climate change is predicted to negatively affect crop productivity. The recent statistical yield literature emphasizes the importance of flexibly accounting for the distribution of growing-season temperature to better represent the effects of warming on crop yields. We estimate a flexible statistical yield model using a long panel from France to investigate the impacts of temperature and precipitation changes on wheat and barley yields. Winter varieties appear sensitive to extreme cold after planting. All yields respond negatively to an increase in spring–summer temperatures and are a decreasing function of precipitation about historical precipitation levels. Crop yields are predicted to be negatively affected by climate change under a wide range of climate models and emissions scenarios. Under warming scenario RCP8.5 and holding growing areas and technology constant, our model ensemble predicts a 21.0% decline in winter wheat yield, a 17.3% decline in winter barley yield, and a 33.6% decline in spring barley yield by the end of the century. Uncertainty from climate projections dominates uncertainty from the statistical model. Finally, our model predicts that continuing technology trends would counterbalance most of the effects of climate change.
abstract_zh: 在世界多个地区，气候变化预计将对作物生产力产生负面影响。近期关于产量的统计文献强调，应灵活考虑生长季气温的分布，以更好地刻画变暖对作物产量的影响。我们利用法国的长期面板数据，估计了一个灵活的统计产量模型，以考察气温和降水变化对小麦和大麦产量的影响。冬性品种在播种后对极端低温表现出敏感性。所有作物的产量都对春夏气温升高呈负向响应，并且产量在降水超过历史水平后随降水增加而下降。在多种气候模式和排放情景下，预计气候变化都将对作物产量产生负面影响。在RCP8.5高排放情景下，并假定种植面积和技术保持不变，我们的模型集合预测，到本世纪末，冬小麦产量将下降21.0%，冬大麦产量下降17.3%，春大麦产量下降33.6%。气候预测的不确定性占主导地位，超过了统计模型本身的不确定性。最后，我们的模型预测，持续的技术发展趋势将抵消气候变化的大部分影响。

title: Using the Delphi method to value protection of the Amazon rainforest
Modeling the Structure of Adaptation in Climate Change Impact Assessment for Agriculture
